expo.//: This app is 369Chats. Do NOT 'correct' the package to com.alphalize.369chats — an Android package segment is a Java identifier and may not start with a digit, so the package is chats369 while the slug is 369chats. Changing either one requires a matching Android client in google-services.json and a fresh dev-client build (the deep link is exp+<slug>).

expo.//eas: projectId below was minted by `eas init` on an account we control, replacing one that belonged to another owner under the old slug. There is intentionally no `owner` key — EAS infers it from the logged-in account, and hardcoding it is what blocked builds before. The FCM V1 service-account key is stored PER EAS PROJECT, so if this id ever changes again, push silently stops until `eas credentials` re-uploads it (see FIREBASE_PUSH_SETUP.md).
